description: Warning sent to a Student Route visa holder when their visa or BRP card is approaching expiry. Triggered automatically by the international compliance scheduler at 90/60/30/14/7 days out.
subject: Action needed: your UK visa expires in $days_left days
body:
Dear $first_name,

Our records show that your UK immigration permission is approaching expiry. You must take action to remain a sponsored student on your programme.

Your record:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Student ID:       $student_id
Visa number:      $visa_number
Visa expires:     $visa_expiry_date
BRP number:       $brp_number
BRP expires:      $brp_expiry_date
Days remaining:   $days_left
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What you must do:
• If your course continues beyond your visa expiry, apply for an extension before your current leave ends. Plan for several weeks of processing time.
• If you already have a new visa or BRP, send us a clear scan of both sides so we can update our records and continue sponsoring you.
• If you are graduating, leaving the UK, or switching to another visa route, please tell the International Office so we can correctly close your sponsorship.

Failure to maintain valid leave is a breach of the conditions of your sponsorship and can result in your studies being suspended and a report to UKVI.

Kind regards,
University International Office

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated notification. Please do not reply to this email.
